notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom III v1.2.13 Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version 1.2.13
-Removed some unnecessary API calls.
-Fixes in the translations.

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom III v1.11 patch
notes.notes:

-Added Portuguese Brazil localization
-Fixes in Italian and Polish translations

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom III v1.10 patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version 1.10:

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom III v1.09 patch
notes.notes:
Changes in the version v1.09:
-Changed game fonts. The new fonts are somewhat larger and more readable.
-Added Greek characters to the fonts.
-Added Chinese Han characters to the fonts.
-Removed quotation marks on the text when NPCs speak.
-Fixed shadows glitch on some pine and spruce trees.

notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom III v1.08 patch
notes.notes:
Changes:
-Windows executable is now 64-bit by default. A separate 32-bit executable is provided for backward compatibility.
-Fixed a small visual glitch on low resolution displays.
